record_title: Complete periodicity of the f=1 greedy strict 2-sumfree family
provenance: Direct modular characterization of the f=1 greedy strict 2-sumfree family using a restricted-sum-free residue set and a finite translate covering identity.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprints arXiv:2609.18522v1 and arXiv:2609.16843 are extremely recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The full text of arXiv:2609.18522v1 was inspected; for arXiv:2609.16843, its abstract and the relevant theorem as restated and discussed in arXiv:2609.18522v1 were inspected, but its full text was not separately inspected. No inaccessible source was identified whose metadata specifically suggests the same f=1 theorem. The finite verification artifact supports the formulas and residue identities but is not a substitute for the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
